title: Chapter 759 Breakthrough; Birth Of A Saint!
content:
Chapter 759 Breakthrough; Birth Of A Saint!

Chapter 759  Breakthrough; Birth of a Saint!

Demon Palace.

A large group of powerful demons stood in line in front.

With their protection, even a fly would find it difficult to fly in.

However, Lin Fan, Qiu Ziqian, and Lin Yulian appeared in front of the door and walked in.

"Dad, be careful of these big demons. They are very powerful and might know me."Lin Yulian said carefully.

"Be careful…"

At first, Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian were very worried.

But soon, their mouths were wide open.

That was because Lin Fan brought them through the door.

However, the demons at the door did not seem to see it. They continued to stand quietly on both sides.

Even after the three of them walked in completely, they did not encounter any big demons blocking them.

In fact.

This was normal.

This was because Lin Fan had obtained the Sun Moon Spirit Technique from the system.

This was a technique that could conceal one's figure.

However, in the beginning, it was only a king level cultivation technique.

After that, Lin Fan had forcefully upgraded it into a Holy Lord level skill.

For Lin Fan to cast the Sun Moon Spirit Skill of the Holy Lord level, unless one's cultivation state was close to his or the Holy Lord himself, there was no way that one would be able to discover it.

When the three of them reached the depths of the Demon Palace, Lin Yulian finally couldn't help but say,""Dad, they can't see us?"

Lin Fan smiled," Yes."

"This... He's too powerful." Lin Yulian said sincerely.

"Can you feel where it is?"Lin Fan asked.

"In front!" Lin Yulian pointed ahead excitedly.

Lin Yulian's blood started to boil as she advanced.

This was a tremor that came from the soul.

The three of them could not help but quicken their pace.

A moment later, they appeared in front of a tall, heavy metal door.

At the top of the door, there were three big words written in a flamboyant manner: Treasure Vault.

Two powerful demons stood on both sides, making people feel intimidated.

Lin Yulian tried her best to suppress her excitement and said,""Dad, the thing is inside."

Lin Fan nodded," Alright, let's go in.""

As soon as he finished speaking, he walked forward again.

"Dong dong dong!"

As the three of them got closer and closer.

Lin Yulian's heart began to beat wildly, as if it would jump out of her throat at any moment.

On the one hand, he was excited. Soon, he might be able to obtain what he had been thinking about day and night.

On the other hand, he was nervous and afraid. After all, this was the Demon Palace's treasure vault, and the defense was definitely very tight.

"Plop!"

When they got close to the metal door, the eyelids of the demons standing on both sides suddenly sank, and they fell straight to the ground with a dull sound.

Then, the metal door let out a crisp sound and opened wide.

"Phew!"

The dense spiritual energy was like a tidal wave, whistling toward the faces of the three of them.

At the same time, all kinds of treasures appeared in front of the three of them.

Lin Yulian's gaze fell directly on a pearl that was shining with a fiery red light in the middle. She said excitedly,"Dad, over there!"

Lin Fan raised his hand and the pearl flew into his hand.

Then, he handed it to Lin Yulian.

"Whoosh!"

The moment the orb touched Lin Yulian, it turned into a stream of light and quickly entered her body.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan's hands were drawing in the void as a series of strange talismans shot out and entered Lin Yulian's body.

Lin Fan had long since learned from the system that Lin Yulian would obtain the memories of the Immortal Phoenix after coming into contact with the pearl.

What he was doing now was to seal the Immortal Phoenix's memories so that his daughter would not be affected in any way.

After a long time, Lin Yulian slowly opened her eyes. Golden light flickered in her eyes.

"Phew!"

At the same time, a powerful aura spread out from her body.

"Yulian, how are you?" Qiu Ziqian asked."

"Mom, it's fine now. I'm fine now!" Lin Yulian said happily. Furthermore, my cultivation level has broken through to the universe level!"

"Really?" Qiu Ziqian asked excitedly. That's great!"

"Yulian, Ziqian, shall we go back now?" Lin Fan asked."

"Alright." The two of them said in unison.

With a wave of his hand, everything in the treasure vault entered his internal dimension.

Even though the items in the treasury were of no use to him.

However, bringing it back to Earth for Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, or other people on Earth was still useful.

After all, it was just a casual matter.

"Whoosh!"

In the next moment, Lin Fan, Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian arrived on Earth.

Hu Tian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Su Ningjing, and the others shouted happily when they saw them.

"Lin Fan!"

"Zi Qian!"

"Lin Fan!"

"Zi Qian!"

"Yu Lian!"

A series of calls rose and fell.

Today, the Coiling Dragon Villa, which had been silent for a long time, became lively again.

Lin Fan spent a few blissful days with his loved ones.

On this day, he came to his room.

Lin Fan took in a deep breath and said,""It's about time to break through."

Breakthrough!

That's right!

The experience of life during this period of time had already allowed his cultivation to reach a complete realm.

The layer of membrane that he had broken through was within reach!

"Phew!"

Lin Fan exhaled out gently, causing the entire Earth to be swept up by a cool breeze.

In the next moment…

Lin Fan's body suddenly shot out a golden light.

This golden light was not dazzling, but very gentle. It illuminated Earth, the Spring Region, the Four Seasons Universe, and many other worlds, making them extremely warm.

All the living beings that were illuminated by the golden light began to have more vitality in their bodies.

The man with high nearsightedness suddenly regained his vision.

The woman with the inconvenient legs suddenly stood up.

The old man, whose heart had just stopped beating, suddenly resumed breathing.

....

Countless people started discussing.

"What's that?"

"Why is there suddenly a golden light?"

"Could it be that an immortal is about to appear?"

"Quickly take a photo and post it on your WeChat Moments."

....

In the universe.

"What kind of light is this? My cultivation suddenly became smoother."

"My mind is so clear."

"This golden light actually covers such a far distance."

....

Some ancient existences that had been sleeping for countless years opened their eyes one after another.

"Could this be…"

"Holy Light!"

"That's right, it's Holy Light!"

" Someone is about to advance to the Holy Lord level!"

"Which fellow daoist is it?"

"I originally thought that the path to becoming a Holy Master had been cut off, but now I see hope again!"

Obviously, the knowledge of these ancient existences far exceeded that of ordinary people.

....

At this moment, Lin Fan's figure continued to rise and rise on Earth.

"Break!"

"Whoosh!"

Billions of rays of light shot into the clouds and traversed the universe.

At the same time, a tall figure appeared in countless worlds, and a melodious, melodious music that struck the heart sounded.

The birth of a Saint was a joyous occasion for heaven and earth!
